+from inkwell.text import excerpt, reading_time, slugify
 
 
 class TextTests(unittest.TestCase):
@@ -10,6 +10,22 @@ class TextTests(unittest.TestCase):
     def test_excerpt_cuts_at_a_word(self):
         self.assertEqual(excerpt("one two three", limit=8), "one two…")
 
+    def test_slugify_basic(self):
+        self.assertEqual(slugify("Hello World"), "hello-world")
+
+    def test_slugify_with_punctuation(self):
+        self.assertEqual(slugify("Hello, World!"), "hello-world")
+
+    def test_slugify_with_numbers(self):
+        self.assertEqual(slugify("Post 2024 Title"), "post-2024-title")
+
+    def test_slugify_edge_cases(self):
+        self.assertEqual(slugify("---Start---"), "start")
+        self.assertEqual(slugify("End---"), "end")
+        self.assertEqual(slugify("---Middle---"), "middle")
+        self.assertEqual(slugify(""), "")
+        self.assertEqual(slugify("!@#$%^&*()"), "")
+
 
 if __name__ == "__main__":
-    unittest.main()
+    unittest.main()
